title: Baked Russian Mushroom Pilaf
description: A flavorful and savory pilaf dish with mushrooms and spices, baked to perfection.
instructions: In a large oven-safe pot or Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the uncooked rice, chicken broth, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
If using cheese, sprinkle it on top of the pilaf and return to the oven for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
